_comment: Clef (27B) Index on the full 12,104-row DEV slice with every Index phase (S2 decide, S2c 32k arm, S2b native) on transformers' torch reference GDN (CLEF_GDN_PATH=reference, JOB_SPEC 4d): job-jxevr (art-g7mqf) stopped at S1 on kernel_path max |dp| 0.027 > the pre-registered 0.02 (parity vs systemone passed, 5.0e-5); the tolerance is NOT changed, the decide runs on the reference arm instead. kernel_path is still run and reported; parity still gates. Caps: job-d2u54's measured fast index rate (rederive: 46.2 min full DEV) x a conservative 4x reference slowdown = 180 min expected; index cap 250 = 1.39x (rederive rule: >= max(1.3x, 1.28x/0.95) = 243). The S1 reference preflight gates on the reference arm's own measured rate (kernel_path per_row.ref_ms). S2c 32k (51 rows) and S2b native: 4x the fast phases' expected minutes as caps (45 / 27). DEV only.
no_verdict_reason: baseline measurement of a frozen external checkpoint (Clef 27B) on the Index DEV slice: numbers are reported with CIs, nothing is promoted or selected, so there is no verdict; stop conditions are in JOB_SPEC 4b
pricing: jobs/clef_baseline/price.py: job-sgihj measured Clef-flash rates; Clef planned at the card's 5.39x median-latency ratio (FLOPs ratio 3.52 is the optimistic reference); GDN=reference: x4 planning slowdown on job-d2u54's measured 2.373x rate (price.REFERENCE_SLOWDOWN_FLOOR)
